fields.name: Peers
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3307970 (~esv::TimelineSystem::ConfirmPeerCreation) fetches the component of the timeline entity (bg3.exe+0x3314320) and, for a confirmed create handshake, appends the handshake's peer id as a 4-byte element (grow bg3.exe+0x5C3D00, 'data[size++] = peer'). bg3.exe+0x330C7C0 adds the empty component (bg3.exe+0x3315180) only for timeline types 7 and 9 ('(type - 7) & 0xFD == 0').

open_questions: The array's name is descriptive (peers that confirmed the creation of the world cinematic).
second_pass: Offsets and element width are from Windows code (bg3.exe+0x3307970 appends a 4-byte peer id); live instances show a heap pointer with capacity/size 0..1 at +8/+0xC, as an Array<int32_t> should.
